title: Analyst Athena Query

request.justification: Running quarterly revenue analysis on production data warehouse

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits Athena query actions in prod with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Data Analysts have broad read access for analytics — Athena queries are their primary tool across all environments

title: Wrong Team EC2 Stop

request.justification: Payments team asked me to stop their staging instance while they are on vacation

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped requires team match; core team developer cannot manage payments team EC2 instances

teachingPoint: Favors between teams don't override policy — each team must manage their own resources or escalate properly

title: GuardDuty Investigation

request.justification: Investigating suspicious API call patterns flagged by automated alerting

expected.explanation: GuardDuty findings are restricted data; ABAC rule blocks access without a ticket ID

teachingPoint: Even urgent security investigations need a ticket — the audit trail is non-negotiable for restricted data

title: Cross-Team Lambda Invoke

request.justification: Need to trigger analytics ETL to test payment data integration

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped requires team match; payments team cannot invoke analytics team Lambda functions

teachingPoint: Cross-team Lambda invocations are blocked by ABAC — use proper integration patterns instead

title: Intern Prod Database

expected.explanation: ABAC rule intern-no-prod denies Interns access to production environments

teachingPoint: ABAC catches this even though the action seems harmless — interns are blocked from all prod access

title: Developer Starts Own Staging

request.justification: Starting staging instance for integration test run

expected.explanation: Developer role permits ec2:StartInstances in staging, team scope matches

teachingPoint: Own team + staging + allowed action = green light through both RBAC and ABAC

title: Auditor CloudTrail Restricted

request.justification: Investigating access anomaly flagged in compliance dashboard

expected.explanation: Restricted data access requires a ticket ID per ABAC rule, even for Auditors

teachingPoint: Auditors have the role permissions but ABAC still requires a ticket for restricted data

title: Security IAM Review Staging

request.justification: Reviewing staging service role permissions for security assessment

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role permits IAM read actions in all environments; internal classification is within limits

teachingPoint: IAM read access for Security Engineers is unrestricted by environment — they audit everywhere

title: Developer Deletes Other Team Data

request.justification: Analytics team asked me to clean up their old dev reports

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped blocks core team from deleting analytics team resources

teachingPoint: Destructive actions on another team's resources are doubly dangerous — ABAC team scoping prevents this

title: Analyst Checks Staging DB

request.justification: Checking staging database specs for query optimization

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits rds:DescribeDBInstances in staging with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Data Analysts can check database metadata in staging — useful for query planning and optimization
